title: Fix course overall output progress not updating and exclude skipped jobs from progress_percent
todo_items: Refs: ISSUE-036. (1) Backend orchestrator.py (list_courses_summary & get_course_detail): exclude skipped jobs from active total when computing progress_percent. (2) Frontend studio-batch.js / studio-start.js: when queue counts change in fetchStatus() (or during the 15s poll / after syncFromNotebookLM / retryUpload / regenerateArtifact), call fetchCourses() so #courseContainer cards, top-bar #coursePick, and 課程目錄 #courseList update their overall progress; also refresh currentStudyCourse and loadTodayPanel() when done count increases; filter out skipped jobs in renderStatusBar(). (3) Add regression test in tests/test_course_settings.py.
